notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until August 31 (Pacific Time)!

Summary of the rewards
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, EMOPET Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

How do I join?
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 06 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/e4ccc068231f833bc18ecba7cab577217dd99ce0.png

THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 4 
[PERIOD] : 2023.05.18 ~ 2023.05.24
[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.
3. REWARDS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE
4. Higher place winner don’t receive

notes.title: 2022 TOURNAMENT LEAGUE WILL START.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bfb1b0c2235f6d1eaf1a89eb68ecb8f16f2b52b6.png

THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 4 
[PERIOD] : 2022.11.24 ~ 2022.11.30
[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.
3. REWARDS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE
4. Higher place winner don’t receive 

REWARD LIST
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d1a802966caf7a501b8f2d685106fe787ff6ea9c.png

[ADDITIONAL REWARD]
1. This reward can be awarded multiple times. Therefore you can still receive these rewards even if you have received basic reward.
2. All winners will receive a “Discount Coupon Box2” as a reward.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d5dcdc23bd1989d3aa013e569b75081d9851fcd.png

Thank you for playing Lovebeat. And we hope you enjoy “2022 TOURNAMENT LEAGUE”.

Regards.
GM Lovebeat.

notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until December 7 (Pacific Time)!

Summary of the rewards
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

How do I join?
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 14 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: NEW MODE. SAVE THE EARTH!
notes.content:
[NEW MODE : SAVE THE EARTH!]

Defeat Alien invader’s U.F.O and SAVE THE EARTH!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/b8dbf572b072f8c95e9cafeb04e4f79343afcc77.png

[HOW TO START]

YOU CAN SELECT MUSIC BY DEDICATED MUSIC SELECTION UI

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2e2a80f458816295978fc565f67ebcda9f7c075f.png

You need at least 4 players to start a game.
And game is run on a dedicated stage to defeat the U.F.O.

[HOW TO ATTACK U.F.O]

The GOAL of this mode is DESTROY 5 LASERS of U.F.O and SAVE the earth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d9ac43738ea1f7adab1290c08b7a43e74aa83b1.png
 
You can destroy the laser by all players score WOW.
Players score WOW launch missiles together and attack U.F.O.
Lasers are 3 types and getting more armor. So it becomes more difficult to destroy.
One tip is, More people attacks, it’s armor becomes lower.

[SUPER MISSILE]

When you score WOW, you can see super missile on the right.
If you score WOW 5 times in a row, you can fire SUPER MISSILE!.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/146202a96f20134e3ec061c149949eaef7f33edc.png 

Super missile does critical attack. And inflict super damage 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/5f137594f799a2c49f44404856ea55d2fec5fbef.png

[FINAL BATTLE]

When you destroy 4th Laser, FINAL BATTLE activates. And Alien’s hidden Weapon is revealed.
At final battle, If you don’t score WOW, you will be lifted into the air.
When you are lifted, you should skip next keynote. So please be careful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/65e1fb6b61c6aeca2f2d81794d7b6dab5221b7e9.png

[REWARD]

Even if you couldn’t destroy all the lasers, you can receive earth defense bonus by how many lasers you destroyed.

If you destroyed all lasers and Successfully defended the earth, you can receive U.F.O Parts. 
There are 3 types of U.F.O parts. The more people you play, the more likely you are to collect medium and large parts.

[U.F.O Package]

U.F.O parts are used to exchange “U.F.O package” At Exchange center.
You can visit Exchange center at my information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d15c3d2eb849f399719d90034033363958094a88.png

notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until June 9 (Pacific Time)!

Summary of the rewards
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

How do I join?
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 14 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 4 WILL START.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/260ab67b54727ed039eddcb82e8f283e7ee39e3c.png

THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 4 
[PERIOD] : 2021.11.11 ~ 2021.11.17
[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.
3. REWARDS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE
4. Higher place winner don’t receive 

REWARD LIST
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d1a802966caf7a501b8f2d685106fe787ff6ea9c.png

[ADDITIONAL REWARD]
1. This reward can be awarded multiple times. Therefore you can still receive these rewards even if you have received basic reward.
2. All winners will receive a “Discount Coupon Box2” as a reward.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d5dcdc23bd1989d3aa013e569b75081d9851fcd.png

Thank you for playing Lovebeat. And we hope you enjoy “TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 4”.

Regards.
GM Lovebeat.

notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 3 WILL START.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/ce5630785de32e6902baf0defd4dbd174f9e58fa.png


THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 3 
[PERIOD] : 2021.09.30 ~ 2021.10.06
[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.
3. REWARDS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE
4. Higher place winner don’t receive 

REWARD LIST
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d1a802966caf7a501b8f2d685106fe787ff6ea9c.png

[ADDITIONAL REWARD]
1. This reward can be awarded multiple times. Therefore you can still receive these rewards even if you have received basic reward.
2. All winners will receive a “Discount Coupon Box2” as a reward.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d5dcdc23bd1989d3aa013e569b75081d9851fcd.png

Thank you for playing Lovebeat. And we hope you enjoy “TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 3”.

Regards.
GM Lovebeat.

notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 2 WILL START.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1c5e772fc426e25a6f80b1b9db7b4df780a19dce.png

THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 2 
[PERIOD] : 2021.05.13 ~ 2021.05.19
[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.
3. REWARDS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE
4. Higher place winner don’t receive 

REWARD LIST
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d1a802966caf7a501b8f2d685106fe787ff6ea9c.png

[ADDITIONAL REWARD]
1. This reward can be awarded multiple times. Therefore you can still receive these rewards even if you have received basic reward.
2. All winners will receive a “Discount Coupon Box2” as a reward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d5dcdc23bd1989d3aa013e569b75081d9851fcd.png

Thank you for playing Lovebeat. And we hope you enjoy “TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 2”.

Regards.
GM Lovebeat.

notes.title: Challengers Event Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until May 27 (Pacific Time)!

Summary of the rewards
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

How do I join?
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.

notes.title: NEW MODE. SAVE THE EARTH!
notes.content:
[NEW MODE : SAVE THE EARTH!]

Defeat Alien invader’s U.F.O and SAVE THE EARTH!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/a71b163898b92ac8acd4cf672bf390baf52eb283.png 


[HOW TO START]

YOU CAN SELECT MUSIC BY DEDICATED MUSIC SELECTION UI

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2e2a80f458816295978fc565f67ebcda9f7c075f.png

You need at least 4 players to start a game.
And game is run on a dedicated stage to defeat the U.F.O.

[HOW TO ATTACK U.F.O]

The GOAL of this mode is DESTROY 5 LASERS of U.F.O and SAVE the earth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d9ac43738ea1f7adab1290c08b7a43e74aa83b1.png
 
You can destroy the laser by all players score WOW.
Players score WOW launch missiles together and attack U.F.O.
Lasers are 3 types and getting more armor. So it becomes more difficult to destroy.
One tip is, More people attacks, it’s armor becomes lower.

[SUPER MISSILE]

When you score WOW, you can see super missile on the right.
If you score WOW 5 times in a row, you can fire SUPER MISSILE!.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/146202a96f20134e3ec061c149949eaef7f33edc.png 

Super missile does critical attack. And inflict super damage 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/5f137594f799a2c49f44404856ea55d2fec5fbef.png

[FINAL BATTLE]

When you destroy 4th Laser, FINAL BATTLE activates. And Alien’s hidden Weapon is revealed.
At final battle, If you don’t score WOW, you will be lifted into the air.
When you are lifted, you should skip next keynote. So please be careful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/65e1fb6b61c6aeca2f2d81794d7b6dab5221b7e9.png

[REWARD]

Even if you couldn’t destroy all the lasers, you can receive earth defense bonus by how many lasers you destroyed.

If you destroyed all lasers and Successfully defended the earth, you can receive U.F.O Parts. 
There are 3 types of U.F.O parts. The more people you play, the more likely you are to collect medium and large parts.

[U.F.O Package]

U.F.O parts are used to exchange “U.F.O package” At Exchange center.
You can visit Exchange center at my information.

notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON WILL START.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/05e5bf5340d4026c29ab447ddcd910bad252ad98.png

THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 1 

[PERIOD] : 2020.11.19 ~ 2020.11.25

[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.

REWARD LIST
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d1a802966caf7a501b8f2d685106fe787ff6ea9c.png

 
[ADDITIONAL REWARD]
1. This reward can be awarded multiple times. Therefore you can still receive these rewards even if you have received basic reward.
2. All winners will receive a “Discount Coupon Box2” as a reward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d5dcdc23bd1989d3aa013e569b75081d9851fcd.png 


Thank you for playing Lovebeat. And we hope you enjoy “TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 1” like you enjoyed pre season.

Regards.
GM Lovebeat.

notes.title: New Content, “Fam Occupation” UPDATE!
notes.content:
Fam competition content “Fam Occupation” is updated and open until November 4 @10PM (Pacific Time)!

[!!FAM OCCUPATION UPDATE!!] 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/02f3cbe8eed13c4a90ce2592daec14d5b6c46309.png

WHAT IS FAM OCCUPATION?
For limited period, conquer tiles as many as you can. And acquire ‘POINT’. A FAM with most point wins.

CONDITION TO JOIN
If you want to join, you should satisfy these condition.
CAN JOIN : 
-. Anyone who joined to a Fam.
CAN NOT JOIN :
 -. Someone who joined a Fam after “Fam Occupation” starts.
 -. Someone who changes(include quit/ban/disband ) a Fam.

HOW TO JOIN
Click Fam occupation Icon and activate “Fam Occupation” page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/ffeeaed47eb7cc1fbdee0e35c91d13b52b756653.png
Click this icon at menu.

PROCESS OF FAM OCCUPATION
Fam Occupation repeats every week during the period.
FAM OCCUPATION STARTS : Every Thursday 18:00
FAM OCCUPATION ENDS : Every Sunday 23:00
RECEIVE REWARDS : From Monday 00:00 to Tuesday 23:00

RECEIVING TICKETS
10 tickets will be charged 00:00 every day during the period. Unused tickets expire before charging. Please use it. You can have a maximum of 10 tickets.

HOW TO PLAY
At map, you can check Occupation status real time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/b48565013ba3a4d18317a4369841f2480ded9151.jpg

Not Occupied
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/3d899a20d0c165e4e5999e116e81fbfe0ebb4b62.png

Occupied by our FAM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/33d6194d0bf4ad6e8713161bdc66c5d0cbe49706.png

Occupied by other FAM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/775ee2231f02c6fa4b7641ec6734c435753c6be7.png


HOW TO CHECK OCCUPYING CONDITION
When you click a tile, You can check Tile’s condition to conquer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2fb19582cfe8b8f14ce9fda30379f55f742e9ce1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/743a7f7a965ce88c6cd743ed08c662eb4b3861d8.png

HOW TO CHECK OCCUPATION AVAILABLE TILE(ON/OFF)
Click “Not occupied” button at right menu to toggle. On/Off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/a83a06e49f5aa57cf0734c2429d0fd0530973658.png

FAM OCCUPATION WAITINGROOM
You can make Fam Occupation waitroom when this condition is met.
-. You should be able to join Fam Occupation.
-. You should have enough LEVEL to try.
-. You should have tickets equal to or greater than the tile’s required tickets..

If your fam member make a waitingroom for fam occupation, you can enter th room. (You should have enough level and tickets too).

OCCUPATION SUCCESS/FAIL
At result screen, you will know Occupation was successful.

OCCUPATION POINT
- When you are successful, you receive ‘Occupation Point’.
- If you lost a tile to another Fam, you will lost received ‘Occupation Point’ 
- There is two kind of Occupation Point.
-. Tile Occupation Point : Point for each Tile.
-. Area Occupation Bonus : When you occupy a group of tile, you will receive ‘Area Occupation Bunus’. There is 14 group.

RANKING
- Ranking Calculation
 -. When Fam Occupation ends, Ranking will be calculated.
 -. Ranking is determined by total Occupation Point 
-. When you score a tie
  -. In this case. These Fam are count as ‘Lowest rank’ of their point.
    Example : When Fam ‘A’ scores 50 and Fam ‘B’, ‘C’ scores 35. They are ranked as 3rd place. Not 2nd


REWARD
You will receive rewards as below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/194ae9e8da4da442abb06ef3f651d8b7346e6dc4.png

You can get one if these from Accessory Box (rare)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/e794dd19c9370942b9e0cc82fa158e4b96466476.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/f87724575672890dd22ca845fd344d043369d601.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/24308bcf629339027a723e57965a6f444a97757f.png

NOTICE
When you are detected as an abuser or is using hack, your account and Fam members can be imposed sanctions. Please be careful and play fair.

notes.title: NEW MODE “DEFEAT WIND DJINN” OPEN!!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/021691484c0393c6847fe979157f37ad0f40611a.png



Stormy new mode, “Defeat Wind Djinn” just arrived!

If you Successfully defeat Wind Djinn, You can get material for treasure box.
 

So. Do you want to know how to? 
Let me show you how to.


[HOW TO PLAY]

1.	Get a ticket 

You can get a ticket at shop. 
( At September 2 update, every character will receive one as gift )
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/81d5e54d7a3efbb9f0cf0a609589bc695ac6d7b4.png

2.	Create room
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/c47dc47e7265ef231650867766a553672194da57.png

When you have ticket, you can select “Defeat Wind Djinn” mode at create room.

[Lobby → Create a game room→ Game Mode → Defeat Wind Djinn]
*You can see when you have Wind Djinn ticket only.

 
3.	Select Music and Difficulty.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/af8a85f31e86968f025c76b66972bc005534b741.png

Select Music
Difficulty is set automatically by selected music.

~* Mode difficulty by music *~

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/fe9e28aabed56c991cc580fa04a959cd046a8ad8.png

 
[How to Defeat Wind Djinn]

By Wind Djinn’s condition, you may pushed away and may drop from cliff

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/e301340cc363c70d8f9b2c02a65cc505954003c3.png
 

If a player score WOW, “DASH TIME” guage will be filled.
If guage is full, “Dash Time” happens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1629811ece0cbf8e171f7128e030500c15244d83.png
 
At dash time, there is no arrow key, but you should hit space fast.
Your character will go forward by guage.

Every 3 times of Dash Time, Wind djinn gets angrier.
As anger step of Wind djinn, You should get a verdict, or pushed away.
If any of your team drops from cliff, Immediately mission fails and playing ends..

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d420b368693063f40a900800827c77d447ecf3a0.png

If all players get to Sealed Stone before music ends, you’ve Defeated Wind djinn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/630c778b79761c1c6df91cfa7eeb991bd8c1d8f7.png

When it is successful, you can flip card to select rewards.
If you don’t flip, automatically selected
Number of material is determined randomly and delivered to your inventory.

[How to exchange reward.]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/4c7a413f0f6e5d63db6b150dcbb6f451ede98582.png

At “My Information”, you can visit exchange center.
If you have enough material, you can exchange with treasure box.

[ REWARDS ]

When you exchange item, you can get one of these items at random.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/6ca58686fa28509844d731c782367873ee270f31.png

notes.content:

Now, use unnecessary dye to make Magic dye!

notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until August 20 (Pacific Time)!

notes.content:
Treasure hunt has been renewed and Trade system updated.

Treasure Hunt Renewal

- Number of treasure materials increased to 60.

 - Material Randombox


Trade System Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/9965aae8c603db5ae9d619eefa79f1bc00cf1848.png

- Trade System is…
  Trading system between treasure materials and ‘heart’

How To Trade
1. At waiting room, click and select trade. When opponent accept, trade pop up opens.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/8cce09421336078c50db736077b42fbc8db51191.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bbc8e659e53870550e5a99fc18037478eeaf434a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/dc734106fcb5d913011afab71da001384f92e2f2.png

2. Select trading items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d2e264ed7fcd622f412f4d163fda62110c538661.png

3. When you trade material, Please select material and number.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/90645a185af80bfc303ee5488ab0939c4cdf5173.png

4. If you trade heart, please input number of hearts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1f76fd9e12fec68994a0b67b583e3c09e7511236.png

5. when items are selected correctly, Click ‘Item Lock’ Button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1d5c4f2190b0916bf640112019cee962f11820cc.png

6. When Both user do Item Lock, ‘Make deal’ button activates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bbe53b546eefd3f2390398d888274cec54e973b6.png

7. After both player agree deal, trade ends.

Before trade, Don’t forget trading fee!

1. For each slot, 5 heart will be charged as fee
2. Trade fee increases proportionally by number of registered heart. (15% as fee)
3. Only buyer pays trade fee.
4. When trade is done, trade fee is reduced before heart is sent to the other.

notes.title: Challengers Event Grand Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until May 14 (Pacific Time)!

Summary of the rewards below:
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

How do I join?
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until May 14 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: Hotfix 02.03.2020
notes.content:
We updated a game to fix an error which the game doesn't run. Please restart the Steam client to download this update.

Patch Note
1. Fixed an error which the game doesn't run.

If the problem persists after this update
Please try our basic troubleshooting as in following:

1. Run Windows and Steam as an administrator:
- How to:
  A. Windows Admin.
    1) Select “Start” and type “CMD“.
    2) Right-click “Command Prompt” then choose “Run as administrator“.
    3) If prompted, enter a username and password that grants admin rights to the computer.
    4) Type: net user administrator /active:yes
    5) Press “Enter“.
  B. Steam
    1) Right-click Steam
    2) Run it as an administrator
2. End unnecessary programs and anti-virus programs.
3. Allow the game through Windows Firewall.
4. Update your Windows and graphic drivers up to dated.
5. Delete a GameGuard folder located in LoveBeat installation directory.

If your issue doesn't resolve with the troubleshooting above, please submit your information to lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr:

a. Steam account
b. LoveBeat avatar's name (if you have)
c. Detailed description of your problem
d. Screenshot or videos showing your problem (if available)
e. DxDiag.txt
 - How to create it?
   1) Press Windows Key + R.
   2) Type DxDiag and press Enter.
   3) In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information.
   4) Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save.
   5) Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool.
f. GameGuard.zip
  - How to create it?
   1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory
   2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
   3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
   4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

notes.title: [Content Guide] Produce 7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/f06f9bc66bf43d071f9655d0872f28a0949fb6f0.png
Hello, Dancers!
It’s time to debut and be a Celebrity! Produce 7 is the customized contents for you.
High Level Dancers! Be a Producer and cast Trainees.
New Dancers! Don’t be shy and just apply to be a trainee. With other Trainees and your Producer will help you.
To be a Celebrity, just follow my lead~


Trainee
Only Dancers below level 15 can be a Trainee.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/7b4cba6beb12bce69f5d9b8a2d5f05dc13f51468.png
How to Apply
You can select a Producer from Producer screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/fa9785a4968118c1770465798c81bd1835da51c2.png

Mission
You can find Missions at the left side of Waiting room.
Training Missions are available only when you are Trainee.
If you clear Trainee Mission, can get Training Point and could be more skilled higher rank Trainee(Max. S).
Don’t hesitate to be a Trainee, Produce7 help your growth.


Producer
Only Dancer over level 30 can be a Producer.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/da794208fe30094ff2ade881df1978d587ea4b16.png

Cast
Producer can cast max. 7 Trainees.
Mouse over and click applicant, then you can find the command “Cast”.

Reward
Producer gets EXP and Beat from Trainees.
Hard Trainees will give you more EXP and Beats.
Take care your Trainees and be a friends of them.
Keep in touch with your lucky 7 Trainees and raise your reputation!

Release Trainees
Producers! Do you want to know how to KICK lazy Trainees from your list?
There is a way.
"/release [nickname]"
And I'm looking for another way to help the way to release trainees by system. But it will take more time.

Produce7 is waiting for your Debut.

notes.title: [Updated] GameGuard Error Issue
notes.content:
The issue's been revised. Please check if you can access to the client. If you're having the same problem, please contact LoveBeat Support: lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr for the assistance. Thank you!



Good day, Dancers!

Recently, some of the players are having a GameGuard issue when playing.
We're now figuring out the way to fix the problem, but it may take some time to find the cause.
If you see the error message 'GameGuard initialization error: 230' while playing the game, please contact our Support with your 'GameGuard.zip' file.

Here is the sample of error message pops up.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c1c3f8aad702c9ba8ebc942ce6465caf3f3ae418.jpg

Please refer below information for self-solution
• please try below to make sure if there’s no process that might cause disconnection while playing LoveBeat.
• Please close the unrelated program/process when open the LoveBeat client.
• Please update the vaccine program you’re using the latest version.
• If the same issue happens repeatedly, please temporally inactive your vaccine program, and check if the same issue still happens.

How to create GameGuard. zip?
1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

Contact to LoveBeat Support
- lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr
- Please don't forget to attach the 'GameGuard.zip' file for the faster processor

We're very sorry for the inconvenience, and will try to fix the issue as soon as possible.
Thank you.

For the ShoutOut issue, GMs are keep monitoring in-game, to prevent any chaos in Chatting. We're developing system to solve the ShoutOut issue, and it is planned to be updated during March :)

notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Support Guide for Disconnected Players
notes.content:
Hello, Dancers!

Any problem in playing the game? Please contact to LoveBeat Support: lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr

Before sending email, please refer this posting that may help to resolve the problem even faster!

We may need your.....
[olist]Steam account name
LoveBeat in game name
Detailed description of your problem
- Such as the date problem happened, how often it occurred, the error message that pops up... and so on.
If you can take a screenshot or recorded video, it would be very helpful![/olist]

Self solution that may help
Are you having a problem with playing the game? ːSurprisedLalabitː
Our developers are trying to optimize the game for every player, but well.. it still happens!
Here are some small tips that may help out your case. Please check if there's anything you can try!

1. Check if it is a GameGuard problem
- In some PCs, GameGuard doesn't work properly. In this case, you may see the messages like
Failed to check GameGuard
GameGuard connection failure
Game or GameGuard has been falsified
or any other messages related to 'GameGuard'.
In this case, please follow below ːsteamhappyː
Create GameGuard.zip folder
[olist]Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
Right-click on GameGuard folder
Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”[/olist]
Delete the GameGuard folder
[olist]Please delete the GameGuard folder in (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat), and try to open the game again.
If it still doesn't work, please send created .zip file to our Support: lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/olist]

2. Other Possible Causes
- It may due to the bad Network, or low PC spec ːsteamsadː
Please check the network condition and be sure it's not intermittently disconnected
If it were not that case, please send us the DxDiag.txt file to check the spec!
[olist]Press Windows Key + R.
Type DxDiag and press Enter.
In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information.
Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save.
Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool.[/olist]

The information you sent will be used in solving the game connecting issue.
Your question may already be answered in LoveBeat's or Steam's knowledge base, so please refer below links to find out the resolution.
LoveBeat knowledge base (FAQ)
Game Guide
Steam Support

Thank you ːKissingLalabitː

- Such as the date problem happened, how often it occurred, the error message that pops up... and so on.
If you can take a screenshot or recorded video, it would be very helpful![/olist]

Self solution that may help
Are you having a problem with playing the game? :SurprisedLalabit:
Our developers are trying to optimize the game for every player, but well.. it still happens!
Here are some small tips that may help out your case. Please check if there's anything you can try!

1. Check if it is a GameGuard problem
- In some PCs, GameGuard doesn't work properly. In this case, you may see the messages like
Failed to check GameGuard
GameGuard connection failure
Game or GameGuard has been falsified
or any other messages related to 'GameGuard'.
In this case, please follow below ːsteamhappyː
Create GameGuard.zip folder
[olist]Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
Right-click on GameGuard folder
Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”[/olist]
Delete the GameGuard folder
[olist]Please delete the GameGuard folder in (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat), and try to open the game again.
If it still doesn't work, please send created .zip file to our Support: lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/olist]

2. Other Possible Causes
- It may due to the bad Network, or low PC spec ːsteamsadː
Please check the network condition and be sure it's not intermittently disconnected
If it were not that case, please send us the DxDiag.txt file to check the spec!
[olist]Press Windows Key + R.
Type DxDiag and press Enter.
In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information.
Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save.
Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool.[/olist]

The information you sent will be used in solving the game connecting issue.
Your question may already be answered in LoveBeat's or Steam's knowledge base, so please refer below links to find out the resolution.
LoveBeat knowledge base (FAQ)
Game Guide
Steam Support

Thank you :KissingLalabit:

notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Policy on Game Abusing Cases
notes.content:
Hello, This is GM Beat.
Hope everyone's preparing for the wonderful start of the Spring.

Thanks to many players who love to play fair, we could revise the game policy on overall game abusing sanctions including fixed Fam battle.

The policies below are the new policy for in-game abusing and will be enforced from February. The sanctions against abusers have intensified. Please appreciate other players' right and cooperate for the clean LoveBeat.

Criterion of fixed Fam battles
- In the following cases, it will be recognized as a fixed Fam battle. Please do not try any action that may be suspected as fixed.
1) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by forcibly quitting games in the middle of playing. Considering network problem, the standard for the sanctions has revised more rationally to minimize unfair treatments.
2) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by playing with certain Fam(s) only.

Penalties for fixed Fam battles
- 1st penalty: Fam point deduction from the fixed Fam battles
- 2nd penalty: Withdrawal of all Fam points
- 3rd penalty: Compulsory disband the Fam

Sanctions for illegal program detection
- Using a program that has not been officially released to take advantages of the game will be subjected to sanctions.
1) Penalties for Manipulating game plays
- 1st penalty: 7 days of account suspension
- 2nd penalty: Permanent account suspension

2) Penalty for using cash or item operation program
- 1st penalty: Withdrawal of all items and cash gained illegally.
If it is impossible to withdraw all of them, the account will be permanently suspended.
The same penalty will be given to the player who received illegally gained items as an in-game gift.

Inappropriate Chattings and nicknames
Inappropriate or offensive chats and Nickname include Swearing, cursing, porn, hacking, racism, drugs, and the words others may feel discomfort.
This also contains chatting or Shoutout by repeating same chats that give disapproval to others.
1) Penalties for inappropriate chattings
- 1st penalty: Block chatting for 7 days
- 2nd penalty: Block chatting for 14 days
- 3rd penalty: 7 days of account suspension

2) Penalties for inappropriate nicknames
- 1st penalty: Forces to change Nickname with an offer of ‘Name change’ item
- 2nd penalty: Forces to change Nickname (will be no provision of ‘Name change’ item)

Depending on the level of its transgression, more severe sanctions can be enacted to the offenders. For any concern and dispute, please email LoveBeat Support(lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) for the resolution. Revocation is possible if you can confirm that the issue was not intentional. However, we are not responsible for any inquiry disadvantages occurred by restriction.

If you have any concern or suggestion, please feel free to contact our Support and GMs.
Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcement on Fixed Fam Battles Sanction
notes.content:
Hello Dancers, this is GM Beat.

Thank you for playing and loving LoveBeat. I'd like to express a deep appreciation on behalf of our LoveBeat team.

The sanction policy is being implemented at all times in order to eradicate the unfair play in LoveBeat. After the implementation of the sanctions in December, there was a lot of opinions and questions from players regarding the policy. In order to solve the curiosity of players, we’ve decided to make this announcement.


1. Why were the existing policies not applied?

First of all, I’d like to make an excuse for the reason why the existing policies were not applied to December sanction.

As you may know, the existing rules are as follows: 1. Warning to Fam Master, 2. Fam points deduction, and 3. Initializing Fam Grade and Points. However, on December’s sanction, the existing policy had not enforced to the Fam who got the 3rd penalty, and it continued to a suspicion that the policy has been adjusted for the convenience of certain Fam.

As to the conclusion, the revised policy has not been adjusted for the convenience of a particular Fam.

The reason for the implementation of the different policy in December is that the subjected Fam had achieved over Fam Grade 11, which the special Fam reward item is given. Therefore, if the Fam grade is initialized, the possibility of receiving the special reward for duplicated times has raised.

As a result, we are discussing new policies to prevent various side effects, and the sanction in December couldn’t follow the existing policy. We deeply apologize for the inability to inform you in advance.


2. About the Revision of the December Sanctions

After the enforcement of the provisional policy, there were many feedbacks from players regarding the operation of fixed Fam Battles. Thanks to this, we confirmed that the external influence such as the user’s network environment can be influenced in recording manipulated games.

Some of the Fams were asked to re-confirm on their records, and the conditions that might influence on Fam record have noticed. Therefore, we decided to cancel the penalties have been informed in December.

As a result, the first sanctioned Fams will receive a warning cancellation, and the Fams who got more than 2 times of penalties will get the deducted points back on the Jan 25th update.


3. The Direction and Standard of Sanctions for Fixed Fam Battle

We are discussing a new policy for fixed Fam Battle that prevents the side effects of the old policy. The new policy should be acceptable to the majority of users and expected to be enforced in January. After then, we strongly encourage not to take any action that could be suspected as a fixed Fam Battle, and it may lead to intense sanctions. Please noted.


You can send an email to lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr about irrational conduct. If it is not intentional, the sanction may be withdrawn, but disadvantages occurred are not responsible for penalties incurred.

Thank you for your understanding in advance.

notes.title: [Notice] Clean Campaign for better LoveBeat
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/f7d5e88dc9f74e0f4661ab846df9b624db7bd1e1.png
Hello Dancers!
This is GMBeat and I hope everyone's having a pleasant year-end ːsteamhappyː
It is little early, but I wish a Happy New Year to all as well :D

Recently, there were some reports that some players abuse Shoutouts item.
The abuse of swear words and repeated Shoutouts that may cause harm to others may disturb other players. Therefore, we decided to hold Clean Campaign to provide a better game service and not to disturb or harm other players.

Please read below and report the relevant issues that you noticed in the game to LoveBeat Support : lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr

*Notice:
This Campaign is to respect every player who enjoys LoveBeat. Please send reports on any issue if you are having trouble in any topics.
All information reported will be kept anonymous.
Both information about you and the player you are reporting should be included in the mail. Please don't forget to send their in-game nicknames as well.
The evidence of abusing such as screenshots or videos should be included to report.

Reports on Inappropriate Chattings and Nicknames
Please report players who irritate other users by abusing chatting or shoutouts or inappropriate nicknames.
This may include insulting, racism, porn, hacking, drugs, or any other contents which are inappropriate for a G-rated game. In addition, the abusive Shoutouts will be counted in this issue as well.
Please learn more the details at Policies on inappropriate chatting and Nicknames.
If the reports on the same player are called in for several times, the abusive users might be subject to sanctions. Please refrain the abusive Shoutouts and respect other players for clean LoveBeat :)


Reports on Illegal programs
Please report an illegal program modifying or hacking the game.
Please learn more the details at Policy on illegal programs.


Reports on songs that include inappropriate lyrics
Among songs in a LoveBeat's playlist now, please report the songs include lyrics that are inappropriate for a G-rated game.

Thank you for the cooperation ːJoyfulLalabitː

notes.title: Inquiries on Cash Charging
notes.content:
Hello Dancers!
Hope you are all enjoying the scent of Autumn!

Some reports on cash charging have been noted recently. Please follow the below if your cash charging page doesn’t work.


[How to charge Cash]

1. Click the ‘Charge’ button on the right bottom side of the game client.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/18a8be1ddbee71bb524d68f358a0e4a470d3f5ed.png

2. Cash Bundle page pops up
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c43ef156797d0b0307a029355dea24fef59f870c.png

3. Click the amount of cash you would like to purchase

4. This page will pop up if it is working properly
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/aea08ce67c61605989751760ef47de47b6c75579.png

5. If the page doesn’t show up, your Steam Overlay might be inactive. In this case, please follow below.


[Checking the Steam Overlay]

1) Check to activate Steam Overlay when you press Shift+Tab.

2) If nothing shows up, go to:
- Steam > Settings > In-game tab
- Check the box next to Enable Steam Community In-game

In addition, please check LoveBeat’s properties
- Library > Right-click on the game
- Check the box next to Enable Steam Overlay while in-game

If it still doesn’t work, do the following to run a program (Steam.exe) in admin mode.
1) Exit Steam
2) Navigate to the Steam installation folder (C:\Program Files\Steam\ by default)
3) Right-click on Steam.exe, then select 'Run as administrator'

If you didn’t get cash after charging, please email lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr to submit your issue including information following. We will give charged Cash back to your account as soon as we confirm you didn't get it.


[Necessary Information]

1. Steam account
2. LoveBeat name
3. Confirmation/invoice number
4. Purchase time
5. Purchase item and its price
6. Screenshot as evidence

Enjoy LoveBeating! Thank you ːKissingLalabitː

notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Policy on fixed Fam battles
notes.content:
Hello, This is GM Love.

We are fully aware of the harmful effect of fixed Fam battles. For rooting it up, we constantly discussed it. Finally, its policy is decided although it took a long time. We will solve this problem by following measures quickly.

Criterion of fixed Fam battles
- In the following cases, it will be recognized as a fixed Fam battle. Please do not try any action that may be suspected as fixed.
1) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by forcing quit games in the middle of that.
2) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by playing with certain Fam(s) only.

Penalty for fixed Fam battles
- 1st penalty: Give a warning to the Fam’s master
- 2nd penalty: Deduct Fam points from the fixed Fam battles
- 3rd penalty: Initialize the Fam grade (make it level 1)

According to above policy, All of following Fams received a warning. (Here’s the Fam name and last 3 letters replaced with *.)

Eli***
Dinom***
Empi***
Eupho***
Black`S***
.*Silver`Sou***
Ni***

Depending on the level of its transgression, more severe sanctions can be enacted to the offenders. If you have any concern and dispute, you can email to LoveBeat Support(lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) for the resolution. Revocation is possible if you can confirm that the issue was not intentional. However, we are not responsible for any inquiry disadvantages occurred by restriction.

Apart from this policy, we found lots of actions that they get minimum score for rewards (Exp, Beat) and then don’t play anymore. We will change the minimum score higher to prevent this inappropriate acts on August 31 (Pacific Time).

Thank you for your cooperation.

Hello, Dancers.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide a good service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play.

Date and time
[strike]June 21, 2017 @ 10:00 PM - June 22, 1:00 AM (Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-7)

An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include:
New Items
50 parts items, 6 accessories, 8 set items, and 2 balloons

Fam Renewals

Fam Grade extended from 10 to 15.
Fam Story added. Clearing the Fam mission, you may available to get the game bonus and exclusive Fam items.Check for them!

Black Dragon from 'Dragon Series' added in Special Shop's Fam tab. Black Dragon gives extra Fam point, and your Fam needs to be at least 10 Grade.

New Songs
Money (RAP, HIPHOP, LATIN) by JOVI EL NEYCOM
Nothings over by Night Time Blue
Fernweh (feat. Mindmovie) by KEVIN S.
Tune Crashers & SG - Party like a psycho by SG
L'Egotrip by Woochia

Fixes and other changes
Notice banners changed
30 Songs have removed due to the patch volume
HOT songs list changed

Previous Event
New & Ongoing Event (June 22 - July 5, Pacific Daylight Time)

Thank you!

notes.title: [End] New & Ongoing Event (June 8 - June 21, Pacific Daylight Time)
notes.content:
New & ongoing events for you. Check out this post to learn more:JoyfulLalabit:

Events (Pacific Daylight Time)
1. Time Gauge Event (June 8 - June 21)
2. Long Live the Fam Event (June 8 - June 21)
3. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on June

Learn More
1. Time Gauge Event
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c3def7a1c53647df21b1b1ecc4af119c2d70dd6e.png
Time Gauge Event Came Back, Collect Time Gauge and Get Rewards!

What are the rewards?
Couple Card, Name Change, Discount coupons(up to 80%), and... Check for the details!
You can get 1 reward among the list per each step.
You can only get 1 reward per a day. The reward reset time is 12:00 am (Pacific Daylight Time)

2. Long Live the Fam Event
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/829e0f333c9101762f6483c4cb57b7d6679db1f6.png
Introduce your Fam to other LoveBeat players!
The posting will be shared on our official FaeBook page.
In addition, the gifts will be given to every participant, wishing for the prosperity of your Fam!

How to Join the Event

(1) Introduce your Fam on the Artwork. 

(2) The posting should include the Screenshot of your Fam page, the name of the Fam, game nickname of Fam master, and the short description of your Fam in English.
If you have Fam website, don't forget to add them as well.

(3) For the participants, the New Fam Skin "Blue Mojito (7 days)" and the "Fam Mark Change" Items will be given to their Fam masters.
※ The Fam grade should be at least 3 at the end of the event period to get rewards.

(4) Leave your posting link as the comment on this Event post.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/fe9191ff26231bab0deeb90d3b8c73e6b2e97654.png

Gift for Fam members
The gift for participated Fam members is also prepared!
For every Fam members who participated on "Long Live the Fam Event" will get 150,000 beats!

※ The Fam grade should be at least 3 at the end of the event period to get a reward.
※ You should be the member of the Fam at the point event ends(6/21 before maintenance, PDT) to get a reward.

3. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on June
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/cb609abb65855ac634bb11dd16efab0ee8bbecba.png
The monthly perfect attendance award for June updated.
Check the attendance every day and grab 80% off coupon(Set items)!
The Gifts by attendance Stamps has changed, so you don't want to miss them!
Check for the Changed items!

Previous Events
Click here to learn more about previous events

Thank you!

Patch Note
An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include:
Daily Quest updates
Now you can get extra rewards through daily quests changing every day.
You can clear 4 normal quests and 1 hidden quest per day. The Quests will be changed at 4AM (Pacific Time) every day, so don't miss to clear before then! 

New Items
80 parts items, 37 accessories, 8 set items, and 2 balloons

Special Shop renewals
Personal, Couple, and Fam items have added in the Special Shop.
Certain status or level may be required for Special items.
Personal pose 'Comic Dance' added. Player level 70+ can purchase the item.
Couple pose 'Holding Hands' added in the Couple tab. 
New mounts 'Dragon Series' added in Special Shop's Fam tab. Dragons give extra Fam points. You need to be a member of Fam to purchase Dragon mounts.
Check for the image!

Changes on existing items
Personal Pose 'Squirrel Pose', 'Poochy Temptation', and 'Round and Happiness' moved to Special Shop from General Function tab
Couple Pose 'Harana', 'Cutey Kitty', 'Couple Dance', 'Photographer', 'Hit the Wall', and 'Close Together' moved to Special Shop from General Couple tab
Vehicles 'Sweet Candy' and 'Sunflower' moved to Special Shop. You need to be a couple to purchase them.

Requiring Couple level changed
Couple pose 'Photographer': Couple Level 5
Couple pose 'Hit the Wall': Couple Level 5
Couple pose 'Close Together': Couple Level 10


New Songs
This Time by Marc Dollarz by CARTEL
Nothing's Over by IN CAMERA
Call by MARC REEVES
Cup Up Booty Low!! (Prod by Danny E B) by STEVES J. BRYAN
We Will Be Alright by THE DADA WEATHERMAN

Fixes and other changes

have replaced to

notes.title: [End][Event] Clean Campaign Crackdown Period (February 9 - March 8, Pacific Time)
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/754a5e58f2ec96d57a404f42997c27fe2fd56357.png

Hi, this is GM Beat!

For players who care to make a clean LoveBeat, the Clean Campaign Crackdown Period had started!

As you may know, we have conduct rules and policy on inappropriate behaviors and illegal programs. These are intended to make a clean game service and not to disturb or harm other players.

However, some reports about those issues had been noted despite our intent, so we decided to hold a Clean Campaign to get remove the inappropriate acts.

The crackdown period is February 9 to March 8. On this period, rewards will be given to informants. Please read below and report the relevant issue that you have seen to LoveBeat Support: lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr

*Notice:

Both information of you and the player you are reporting should be included in the mail. Please don't forget to send their in-game nicknames.
The evidence of abusing such as screenshots or videos should be included to report.
To prevent the abuse of duplicated reports, the rewards will be given to the first informants only.

Reports on Inappropriate Chattings and Nicknames
Please report players who irritate other users by abusing chatting or shoutouts or inappropriate nicknames. The abusing includes insulting, racism, porn, hacking, drugs, or any other contents which are inappropriate for a G-rated game.
Please learn more the details at Policies on inappropriate chatting and Nicknames.

Reports on Illegal programs
Please report an illegal program modifying or hacking the game.
Please learn more the details at Policy on illegal programs.


Reports on songs that include inappropriate lyrics
Among songs in a LoveBeat's playlist now, please report the songs include lyrics that are inappropriate for a G-rated game.

As mentioned in the Notice above, the reward will be given to the first applicant to prevent issues that may be happened.

Notice
The rewards will be given after Mar 9 patch
Every report keeps anonymously
Rewards will be given to the first reporter only
- The rewards have delivered to your mailbox. Please check for it.


Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Policies on inappropriate chatting and Nicknames (Restrictions)
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Love.

Reports on inappropriate or offensive chatting and Nicknames had occurred constantly. The reported offenders got warnings or restrictions until now. However, since the number of reports has increased recently, we decided to intensify the behavior initiatives for the clean LoveBeat. This policy will be enacted as soon as this post’s up on the web page. Whoever violates the rules will be restricted without any prior notification.

Policies on Chatting and Nicknames
Followings are the leading rules. For the detailed contents, please refer the Steam regulations.
Flame or insult other players
Bypass any filters
Abusing chatting or Shoutout by repeating same chats that give disapproval to others
Inappropriate or offensive chats and Nickname; Swearing, cursing, porn, hacking, racism, drugs, and the words others may feel discomfort.

Restrictions on the reported offenders on chatting
Initial penalty: Warning
Secondary penalty: Block chatting for 7 days
Third time reported: Block chatting for 15 days

Restrictions on inappropriate Nicknames
Initial penalty: Forces to change Nickname with an offer of ‘Name change’ item
Secondary penalty: Forces to change Nickname (will be no provision of ‘Name change’ item)
※ Reported nicknames might be blocked in the system

How to report the abusive users
Whoever notice the abusive or offensive users in the game, please report to LoveBeat CS through email (lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) with the following information:
LoveBeat nickname of the reporter.
The abuser’s LoveBeat nickname.
The screenshots for the evidence of your report. If you are reporting for the inappropriate nicknames, no further description is needed.
A detailed explanation of the situation you’ve encountered.
The exact time when the reporting issue happened.

Depending on the committed violation, more intensive restriction or even a permanent exclusion can be enacted to the offenders. Players who have any concern and conflict to others can send an email to (lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) for the resolution. Revocation is possible if you can confirm that the issue was not intentional. However, we are not responsible for any inquiry disadvantages occurred by restriction.

Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: [End][Event] Christmas Outfits Contest (December 15 - 28, Pacific time)
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/4ac17a478602eb9c6f239a08bb58f7600f9ed9cc.png
Hello, Dancers.

Show your Christmas Look! We’ll give 100% coupon to best 6 outfits and teen's Snowman Set (30days) to all participants. This contest ends on December 28, so be sure to check out this announcement for rules and eligibility.

1. Period
　- Submission: December 15, 2016 - December 28, 2016 (Pacific time)
　- [Strike]Announce winners after event ends[/strike]  Reward Sent on Dec 29 

2. Prize
　- 100% Coupon for The 3 Female Outfits (1 Teen, 1 Idol, 1 Kid)
　- 100% Coupon for The 3 Male Outfits (1 Teen, 1 Idol, 1 Kid)
　- Teen's "Human Snowman" Set (30days) for all participants
　* This Snowman set isn’t same one from X-Mas Mystery Box.

3. How to Join the contest (Submission)
1) UPLOAD Christmas in-game outfit(s) on any site
　- Take a screenshot to show your Christmas theme in-game outfit(s) on LoveBeat Steam.
　- Upload it on any site as many as you want, but each outfit should be different. The more posts on multiple sites, The better chance which you get 100% discount coupon.
　- You can use your native language in the post.
　- Post it in the 'Public' setting, including LoveBeat Steam Link

2) SUBMIT the post's link in Event announcement's comment
　- You have to provide your Steam account, in-game name and a link to your post by adding a comment at this event announcement.
　- Example of Submission

3) RECEIVE Reward
　- We give all rewards after winner announcement. (Delivery date is to be announced.)
　- Only 1 Snowman Set is provided even if you submit many outfits.
　- Best outfits are decided by GM's opinion, referring to the number of post(s) and comment(s) in the post and more.

4. Remark
　- Rules and eligibility are subject to change without prior notification.
　- All entries must be received within the submission date to be eligible to win a prize.
　- You will disqualify if you submit to the wrong place or don't follow the rules above.
　- Good outfits will be posted in LoveBeat Lookbook on Facebook

5. Winners
　-  ‹‹3.Her's outfits! 
　-  Khunmei~'s ourfits! 
　-  DeyHotaro's outfits! 
　-  #Meow#'s outfits! 
　-  Aifeiya's outfits! 

*Notice
- Some participants missed to put LoveBeat steam link on their posts, and I'm sorry we cannot give the reward to those who missed the event terms.
- We were planned to choose 3 female and male winners each, but there were no enough male participants. For that reason, only 2 winners from male outfit section had drafted. 

Thank you for your participation! :JoyfulLalabit:

notes.title: [Edit][Notice] Policy of Transactions refunded or charged back (Sanctions)
notes.content:
Hello, Dancers.

I inform you about purchases refunded or charged back. LoveBeat don’t support to refund Cash, but purchases are refunded or revoked by Valve if it’s fraudulent or disputed and there are people who make unfair profits from that. We will give a sanction without prior notification, according to below policy.

Sanctions

Sanction against player who gain Cash from transactions refunded or charged back. (“Abusers”)
　- 1st sanction: Revoke all Cash from the transactions
　- 2nd sanction: If we cannot revoke all Cash, in other words, if you already used the Cash, your account will be banned permanently.

Sanction against player who received gifts from the abuser. (“Recipients”)
　- 1st sanction: Revoke all Gifts from the abusers.
　- 2nd sanction: If we cannot revoke all gifts – in other words, if you already used the gifts-, your account will be banned for a week (7 days).
　- 3rd sanction: After your account is banned temporarily, your account will be banned permanently if you receive gifts from abusers and we cannot revoke all gifts again.

Abusers

The list below is abusers who we banned permanently. (Pacific time)
　- Banned on November 3: YuuNakam***, Zch***, Zcht***, _Zch***, .Zch***, Habichue***, Natsuki~C*** (7 people)
　- Banned on November 7: Howar*** (1 person)
　- Banned on November 14: TheDance*** (1 person)
　- Banned on January 1: ASadCh*** (1 person)
　- Banned on January 8: Ren***, NatsumiC*** (2 people)
　- Banned on January 22: CherryCr*** (1 person)

 The list below is abusers who we banned temporarily. (Pacific time)
　- Banned on November 10 and remove the ban after 1 week: Z*** (1 person)
　- Banned on November 24 and remove the ban after 1 week: Ze*** (1 person)
　- Banned on January 8 and removed the ban after 1 week: MantabJ***, Ax*** (2 people)

If you have concerns and disputes, it can be resolved by emailing lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr. We can remove a ban if you prove that it’s unintentional, but we assume no responsibility for disadvantage of the sanction and transactions between players.

Thank you.

(Last updated on January 23)

notes.title: [Notice] GameGuard Issue (Update)
notes.content:
Hello, This is GMLove.
First of all, I apologize for the difficulty and frustration.
I've got the report from many players about hacking, cheating and other inappropriate things, so my team updated GameGuard which is game security solution on July 11. We updated GameGuard to improve game security on July 27, but many players have reported problems after that. Therefore, we did roll back previous version @ 8:35 PM on July 28. (Pacific time) I apologize for GameGuard issue once again and will recover LB stamp on July 27, 28 for compensation. You will check the stamp on July 29.
If your problem continues, please check basic troubleshooting below and Contact LoveBeat support when you cannot resolve it with the guide. We will investigate your issue to resolve it as soon as possible.
I appreciate your interest and patience.

Update: We performed GameGuard update to improve its compatibility and fix crashes between GameGuard and anti-virus software on 6:12 PM on August 3. Please close game and then run it again to update game and GameGuard.

Basic Troubleshooting

1. Log on as an administrator
GameGuard needs Windows administrator account. Please try to log on as an administrator and follow the link for your information. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/14028/windows-7-how-log-on-as-an-administrator

2. Delete GameGaurd folder
GameGuard is automatically downloaded and updated when running LoveBeat and Canceling or stopping GameGuard update causes problems. You try to download and update again after you delete GameGuard folder in LoveBeat installation directory.
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat (by default)

3. Turn off or Uninstall anti-virus software
Some anti-virus software block or conflict with LoveBeat, or using 2+ anti-virus software might cause problems. Please turn off or uninstall all anti-virus software including McAfee.

4. End unnecessary processes and software
Certain processes and software cause problems. Please end unnecessary processes and software in Task Manager, such as VPN, Sandboxie, Avast Online Scanner, other games which have game security solution (e.g. Xigncode) and so on.

5. Check the error code
If a message appears, please check what it says. If there is certain number (error code), please follow the link for troubleshooting: http://www.gameguard.co.kr/eng/index.htm

Contact LoveBeat Support

If the problem continues even after performing all of the troubleshooting steps in above guide, you will need to contact LoveBeat Support for further assistance. To ensure that your incident is handled in the quickest and most efficient manner possible, please follow these steps:

1. Prepare DxDiag.txt
Please observe the following instructions to run and save DxDiag.txt:
1) Press Windows Key + R
2) Type DxDiag and press Enter
3) In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information
4) Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save
5) Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool

2. Prepare GameGuard.zip
Please do the following to create GameGuard.zip:
1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory
- By default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

3. Prepare Screenshots
Please take a screenshot of your problem and all running processes in Task manager when you’re faced with the problem. You could open Task manager to press Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
Please follow the link about generating screenshots. http://www.take-a-screenshot.org/

4. Submit Your Support Request by email
Email lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr to submit your request. Please write your LoveBeat name, Steam account, description about your problem and include your DxDiag.txt, GameGuard.zip, screenshot as an attachment to the incident.

notes.title: [End] [Event] GMLove's Special EVENTS (period: 11th February - 9th March, PST)
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/pLOYJLz.png
Thank you for love to LoveBeat! GMLove prepares special event for you.

Edit - This period is on 11th Feb - 9th Mar (before maintenance), but period is changed to start @ 11:30 PM on 10th Feb due to maintenance completed early.


1. Weekend Golden Time
Play the game during event time with the mode, then get additional bonus in each game.

* Date and Time: @4AM - 6AM, @10AM - 12PM, @6PM - 8PM, every weekend (PST)
* Event Mode: Beat PangPang, Couple PangPang
* Bonus: +100 EXP, +300 Beat


2. Fix LoveBeat Text
Please rewrite our text for better English and suitable for content.

Mechanics
Post your rewritten text on "Fix LoveBeat Text" forum follwoing information:
 a. Your LoveBeat avatar's name(IGN)
 b. Screenshot of your suggestions
 c. Text in screenshot which you want to rewrite
 d. Rewritten text by you

Rewards
"All Channel Shoutout" item is provided for each post and the text will be fixed in near future.

* The post which will be fixed is chosen according other player's comments and our staff.
* It's okay to rewrite text regardless of its length, location (in-game, Steam page).
* example: http://steamcommunity.com/app/354290/discussions/8/412446890549216330/


3. Top Couple EXP
We give rewards to couples who gather most couple EXP (couple point) during event period.

Rewards
1st rank: Close Together (Couple Pose, 7days) & Heart Floater (Riding, 30days)
2nd rank: Harana (Couple Pose, 7days) & Heart Heart (Acc, 30days)
3rd rank: Cutey Kitty (Couple Pose, 7days) & Sugar Candy (Balloon, 30days)
4th - 10th rank: Hug Me (20+5)
11th - 20th rank: Hug Me (10+2)
21th - 30th rank: Hug Me (5)

* The couple EXP (couple point) is checked at MA time (10th Feb) and MA time (9th Mar).
* Players have to be couple at maintenance time on 9th March.
* The couple EXP means Increased EXP.
e.g) Couple EXP of A couple is 100 now and their couple EXP is 150 on 9th Mar. Couple EXP of B couple is 0 now (they are new couple) and their couple EXP is 150 on MA time 9th Mar. Even if their couple EXP is same, we check Increased EXP, so B couple ranked higher than A couple. 


4. Heart-Back Service
We give Heart and addtional rewards to player who buy $1.99 USD or $19.99 USD during event period.

Rewards
All players who buy $1.99 USD (2,000 Cash): 5 Hearts
All players who buy $19.99 USD (23,000 Cash): 20 Hearts

Lottery (Addtional Rewards)
10 players who buy $1.99 USD (2,000 Cash): 5000 Cash
10 players who buy $19.99 USD (23,000 Cash): Permanent "Lovely pink/blue eyepatch" Accessory

* The reward will be provided for just one time for each item even if you buy $1.99 USD or $19.99 USD many times.
e.g) you bought 2 $1.99 USD and 3 $19.99 USD, then, you will get total 25 hearts(5 hearts and 20 hearts).
* The rewards will be provided after 9th March.

Tips and Result (Winners) 
https://www.facebook.com/events/1751356965101017/

Don't miss those events!
Thank you.
